answer: The crystal test I would run is Signed skatepark membership with session log: sessions logged weekly for two years, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the ridge compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The mesa grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
